claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.6, annual return 5%, maximum drawdown 10%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy uses a full sample backtest without any out-of-sample validation. While the research log shows multiple trials, it doesn't indicate a robust out-of-sample test. The claimed performance is also sensitive to the cost parameter. Given these concerns, I recommend paper trading to further validate the strategy before deploying real capital. The costs are also not negligible.
